channel.title: Technology Reading
channel.description: Articles about software, publishing and the open web.

item.title: Current turns RSS reading into a river instead of an inbox
item.description: Current rethinks RSS as a river instead of an inbox: items fade on schedules matched to their type, while readers can tune source speed, mute noisy feeds, follow individual voices and import OPML. The $9.99 Apple app has no subscription, and a web version is planned.

item.title: WordPress launches a private site creator that runs in a browser
item.description: WordPress.org's my.WordPress.net creates private sites entirely in a browser, with no account, host or domain. Built on WordPress Playground, it stores data locally and supports experiments with themes, plugins, drafts and a personal RSS reader.

item.title: The Ankler moves from Substack to Ben Thompson's Passport
item.description: The Ankler is moving its publishing operation from Substack to Passport, a subscription platform from independent publisher Ben Thompson built with Automattic. Axios reports the move will give the outlet more control over its audience, data, bundles, podcasts and events while it keeps a smaller Substack presence.
